tagline.en_US: Run DNS services and manage zones, forwarding, filtering and logs from a browser interface.

description.en_US: Technitium DNS Server is an authoritative and recursive DNS server managed through a web console. It resolves domain names locally, caches queries for improved performance, and blocks network-wide ads and malware using block lists. It supports encrypted protocols including DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-HTTPS, and DNS-over-QUIC, alongside a built-in DHCP server and DNSSEC validation.
